patches.name: Aspect ratio control
patches.description: Adds a Fit/Stretch toggle to the player.

patches.name: Enable speed control
patches.description: Enables playback speed options (0.5x-2.0x) in the video player.

patches.name: Subtitle styling
patches.description: Adds subtitle size, font and outline controls to the player.

patches.description: Removes pre-roll and mid-roll video ads, and the display banners.
